analysis:
This batch contains documentation only: changelog.d/coordinator-reconnect-stall.md (head 1-4) and docs/provider/cli-reference.md (head 444-448 and 1974). The changes describe two behaviours.
(1) A 30 s handshake deadline for TCP, TLS and the WebSocket upgrade, using CoordinatorConnectionHandshake.defaultTimeout, with retry under the existing ExponentialBackoff. This is an availability improvement on TB-002. It does not alter TLS validation, registration or attestation, as far as the docs state.
(2) Drain semantics: stop, restart and start complete a graceful drain without coordinator acknowledgement only when no work remains and no coordinator session is registered. The command then reports "not needed (no coordinator connection)". A registered session must still acknowledge.
Security relevance for integration:
- The "no registered session" predicate must be evaluated atomically with admission closure. Otherwise a reconnect racing the drain could register and accept work, and the drain would skip the coordinator terminal barrier and usage settlement. That would touch provider_serving_availability (A-018) and the billing/usage barrier.
- Logout (A-008, T-053) relies on the drain plus process exit before revocation. Logout docs at base 552-558 say a normal drain timeout refuses logout. The new path lets a disconnected provider drain without acknowledgement, so verify that logout ordering (stop before revoke) still holds and that it confirms exit.
- The handshake timeout must cancel the stalled connection fully, so no half-open socket later registers alongside the retry. Otherwise there could be duplicate endpoint/custody sessions under TB-011 and T-053.
The Swift implementation of these behaviours is not in this batch: ProviderLoop+Lifecycle.swift performLifecycleDrain, CoordinatorConnectionHandshake.swift and ServiceDrain.swift. None of the risks above can be verified from documentation alone. No regression is evidenced by the docs themselves, and the claims stay within the existing threat-model boundaries.
